prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Evidence is still thin for sign_in and reorder, adoption and new_flow, and finish and redesign changes, as only one test has been completed for each.
No clear effect was seen for adoption and redesign changes across 2 tests.
Finish and new_flow changes hurt performance across 2 tests, resulting in negative noise-corrected effects and one test stopped early.
Predictions were generally too high compared to noise-corrected results across most tests, though round 7 predicted lower than measured.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, new_flow: -6.7% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- adoption, redesign: -0.1% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- finish, new_flow: -4.0% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- finish, redesign: -0.6% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, reorder: +0.8% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 17.8%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [choose_path, layout] Story Screen Split Card Layout: Reframe the initial story screen layout into a clean split card structure separating pet lore from path options. (why: The choose_path step has a very high mean time of 514s, indicating users pause or get lost in the unorganized layout.)
1: [sign_in, hint] Sign In Multi Device Account Warning Hint: Display an explicit hint on the sign-in screen reassuring returning users that signing in restores existing pets. (why: Support received 8 emails about pets missing or reset after signing in again.)
2: [adoption, wait_info] Adoption Certificate Naming Inspiration Carousel: Add a carousel of popular pet names and personality ideas directly onto the adoption certificate screen. (why: Adoption takes a long median time (89s) and mean time (1017s), showing users stall when naming or adopting their pet.)
3: [home, wait_info] Desktop Pet Launch Status Notification Toast: Show estimated waiting time and ready notifications on the waiting screen while pet assets initialize in the background. (why: 3 support tickets noted pets failing to appear or app stalling, and home waiting screen takes median 201s.)
4: [finish, redesign] Home Intro Card Spotlight Layout Redesign: Redesign the home intro screen into a spotlight card highlighting primary pet interactions. (why: The finish step has a massive mean duration (5815s) and only 64.8% conversion, showing dropoff right at the final step.)
5: [choose_path, incentive] Pick Path Welcome Sound Effect Greeting: Play a welcoming sound effect and render a friendly mascot greeting component on the initial story screen. (why: The first step choose_path takes median 8s and mean 514s; delighting users upfront increases initial momentum.)
6: [sign_in, reorder] Sign In Deferred After Pet Selection Reorder: Move sign_in to occur after pet friend selection and photo upload, letting users select their companion first. (why: Sign-in conversion sits at 72.9%; building emotional attachment to a selected pet before sign-in improves conversion.)
7: [adoption, hint] Pick Friend Character Trait Comparison Hint: Add clear hint text describing how different pets behave on the desktop during selection. (why: Adoption conversion drops to 60.9% and takes median 89s because users struggle to choose among pets.)

scores.note: Addresses long step duration on choose_path, but lacks support mail backing and requires new card layout UI.
Strong alignment between support tickets (8 emails) and funnel sign-in drop-off; low risk hint addition.
High potential impact given adoption's steep 39.1% drop, but adding a carousel requires new UI components.
Backed by both support tickets and long home waiting time, though target step already has high conversion.
Target step loses many users, but historical finish redesigns consistently underperform or hurt conversion.
Delight feature targeting long mean time on choose_path, requiring media assets and code release.
Reordering flow requires heavy development effort; single historical test showed slight positive gain (+0.8%).
Targets low adoption conversion (60.9%) with low-cost simple hint text configuration.
